SaintapediaFeedbackMode.description: Feedback mode: 'public' (anon-friendly, captcha-on by default, short form) or 'enterprise' (relaxed limits, captcha-off by default, long form, email).

SaintapediaFeedbackNamespaces.description: Namespaces where the widget is shown and the API accepts submissions. Default: main namespace only.

SaintapediaFeedbackRateLimit.description: Max feedback submissions per IP per day in public mode.

SaintapediaFeedbackEnterpriseRateLimit.description: Max feedback submissions per IP per day in enterprise mode.

SaintapediaFeedbackEnableEmail.description: Show optional contact email field (automatically enabled in enterprise mode).

SaintapediaFeedbackRequireCaptcha.description: Require hCaptcha via ConfirmEdit. null = auto (true for public mode, false for enterprise). true/false overrides per wiki.

SaintapediaFeedbackNotifyUsers.description: Usernames (with saintapediafeedback-view) who receive Echo alerts on new feedback. Empty = no Echo alerts. Requires Extension:Echo.

SaintapediaFeedbackNotifyEmail.description: Optional single email address to notify on each new submission (requires $wgEnableEmail / $wgSMTP). false disables.

SaintapediaFeedbackAccessPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page (DB key without prefix) listing groups allowed to manage feedback. Missing/empty page → AccessGroups default.

SaintapediaFeedbackAccessGroups.description: Default groups when the access page is missing or empty. Default is sysop (safe for public wikis). Set to ['user'] or put 'user' on the access page for option C (named accounts, not temps).

SaintapediaFeedbackEmailAccessPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page (DB key without prefix) listing groups allowed to see the optional contact-email field. Separate from the dashboard access page/right so email can be locked to a smaller set than general feedback access. Missing/empty page falls back to EmailAccessGroups.

SaintapediaFeedbackEmailAccessGroups.description: Default groups allowed to see the contact-email field when the email access page is missing or empty. Default is sysop, independent of SaintapediaFeedbackAccessGroups.

SaintapediaFeedbackExportAccessPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page (DB key without prefix) listing groups allowed to download the JSON export. Separate from the dashboard access page/right so bulk export can be locked to a smaller set than general feedback access. Missing/empty page falls back to ExportAccessGroups.

SaintapediaFeedbackExportAccessGroups.description: Default groups allowed to export when the export access page is missing or empty. Default is sysop, independent of SaintapediaFeedbackAccessGroups.

SaintapediaFeedbackRateLimitPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page (DB key without prefix) holding a single integer that overrides the mode-appropriate rate limit (SaintapediaFeedbackRateLimit / EnterpriseRateLimit) without a deploy. Missing/empty/non-numeric page falls back to the PHP config.

SaintapediaFeedbackNotifyUsersPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page (DB key without prefix), one username per line, overriding SaintapediaFeedbackNotifyUsers without a deploy. Missing/empty page falls back to the PHP config.

SaintapediaFeedbackRequireCaptchaPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page (DB key without prefix) holding true/false to override SaintapediaFeedbackRequireCaptcha (and the mode-based auto default) without a deploy. Security-sensitive: editable by anyone with editinterface, not gated by code review. Missing/empty/unrecognized page falls back to the PHP config.

SaintapediaFeedbackShowPublicCountsPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page (DB key without prefix) holding true/false to override SaintapediaFeedbackShowPublicCounts without a deploy. Missing/empty/unrecognized page falls back to the PHP config.

SaintapediaFeedbackEnableTalkLinkPage.description: MediaWiki-namespace page (DB key without prefix) holding true/false to override SaintapediaFeedbackEnableTalkLink without a deploy. Missing/empty/unrecognized page falls back to the PHP config.

SaintapediaFeedbackNotifyWatchers.description: When true and Echo is loaded, notify watchers of the article who may manage feedback (FeedbackAccess). Never notifies users who cannot open the dashboard. At most 100 eligible watchers per submit (scan capped at 1000 watchlist rows).

SaintapediaFeedbackShowPublicCounts.description: When true, show a small public chip with open vs resolved feedback counts on the article (no free-text). Default off — prefer public resolutions list instead.

SaintapediaFeedbackEnableTalkLink.description: When true, show an optional checkbox on actioned to append a short Talk-page note linking to public resolutions (never dumps work notes or raw reader comments).

SaintapediaFeedbackLlmWebhook.description: HTTPS URL that receives POST JSON {count,items} of pending feedback. Empty disables the maintenance script unless --webhook is passed.

SaintapediaFeedbackLlmWebhookToken.description: Optional Bearer token sent as Authorization when posting the LLM batch. Keep in LocalSettings / env, not in the wiki.

SaintapediaFeedbackLlmBatchSize.description: Default number of pending feedback rows posted per ProcessFeedbackLlm.php run (max 500).
